harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a persistent LVM logical volume (srv_data_vg/data_lv) mounted at /srv/data on node1, backed by two loop-device PVs since the node's single disk had no free space. Initial LV was 1000M; extended live to <2.15 GiB (2.1G filesystem) while mounted, with test data preserved throughout. Set up a systemd oneshot service (srv-data-loop.service) to reattach the loop devices and activate the VG at boot, and an /etc/fstab entry so /srv/data auto-mounts. Verified persistence by rebooting node1: boot_id changed, and post-reboot the LV was auto-activated, /srv/data auto-mounted at the grown 2.1G size, and the test file's SHA256 checksum matched pre-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout (lsblk, pvs/vgs/lvs) and found no free block space on the single 20G disk
Installed lvm2 package via dnf
Created two 1200M backing files under /srv/lvmbacking and attached them as loop devices (loop0, loop1)
Created PV/VG (srv_data_vg) on loop0, created 1000M LV data_lv, formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data
Wrote and checksummed a test file in /srv/data
Extended VG with loop1 as second PV, grew LV to <2.15 GiB with lvextend while mounted, live-grew xfs filesystem with xfs_growfs, verified data checksum unchanged
Created and enabled systemd service srv-data-loop.service to reattach loop devices and vgchange -ay the VG early at boot
Added /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data by UUID with systemd ordering dependency on the loop service
Manually simulated boot behavior (unmount, deactivate VG, detach loop devices, then start the service and mount) to validate before rebooting
Captured pre-reboot boot_id and healthy state (mount, size, checksum)
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, polled until exec was available again
Verified boot_id changed post-reboot, verified srv-data-loop.service active, /srv/data auto-mounted at 2.1G, and test file checksum matched

evidence.requirement: LV mounted at /srv/data created and initially populated
evidence.summary: Created PV/VG/LV, formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data, wrote testfile.txt and captured its checksum

evidence.requirement: LV grown to at least 2GB while remaining mounted, contents intact
evidence.summary: vgextend + lvextend to <2.15 GiB and xfs_growfs performed with /srv/data still mounted; df shows 2.1G filesystem; checksum of testfile.txt unchanged and content readable

evidence.requirement: Persistence mechanism configured for reboot (loop-backed LVM has no native disk to auto-discover)
evidence.summary: Created/enabled srv-data-loop.service, added fstab entry, and validated manually (detach/reattach loop devices, restart service, mount) that the setup restores the mount before a real reboot
Captured boot_id c2ffc729-a31e-486e-95de-cf2023dea95c, confirmed service active and /srv/data mounted at 2.1G
systemctl reboot issued in background; exec stream closed as node went down, confirming the restart command was accepted
First poll failed with connection reset (node down/rebooting), second poll succeeded confirming exec available again

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity and recovered state proven post-restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 0dd7a1f7-5e0a-421d-a8e5-d746d93be72c with new boot time, srv-data-loop.service active, /srv/data auto-mounted at 2.1G via fstab, testfile.txt checksum matches pre-reboot value, LV and both PVs show correct grown size
